parameters.name: Engine
parameters.description:
The type of the database engine. Valid values:

*   **mysql**
*   **mssql**
*   **PostgreSQL**
*   **MariaDB**

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description: The resource group ID. You can call the DescribeDBInstanceAttribute operation to query the resource group ID.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun rds describe-character-set-name --engine mysql --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource-group-id rg-acfmy00000 --region cn-hangzhou
